summary.value: This paper provides a machine learning approach to learn stochastic representations that are designed to have low mutual information with he input and hence private. Two reviewers had concerns about the level of formalism in the paper (no clarity about the mechanism-level or user-level privacy) and one questioned the validity of the bounds.
